anomalies.description: Two individuals approach a parked white SUV; one in red appears to confront or interact aggressively with the driver who exits the vehicle. The person in red then moves toward the driver's side door while the other individual walks away. The interaction is sudden and tense, with body postures suggesting possible assault or robbery attempt—no visible weapon, but the proximity, rapid movement, and positioning (e.g., reaching toward the vehicle/driver) are highly suspicious and inconsistent with normal passenger drop-off or casual interaction.

anomalies.description: A person in a red shirt opens the driver's door of a parked white SUV and appears to be exiting or interacting with the vehicle; shortly after, a second person (wearing dark top and light pants) approaches rapidly from the right, reaches the open door, and appears to forcibly pull or push the first person out of the vehicle while grabbing the door frame—suggesting an assault or carjacking attempt. The sudden aggressive movement, open door during interaction, and apparent struggle near the vehicle constitute suspicious criminal activity consistent with robbery or assault.
